verdict.rationale: Fireflies auto-generates action items and summaries after every meeting (fireflies-docs-10) and provides API/GraphQL access to transcripts including analytics and search so action items can be tracked programmatically (fireflies-docs-5, -6, -41), plus AskFred lets users query meeting content in natural language. missing for 10: no explicit doc showing owner-assignment logic for action items or a dedicated 'action items' tracking dashboard/API field, and no independent hands-on verification of accuracy.
